_about.what: Which evidence streams make the weights the scorer uses (read by scoring/derive_weights.py).

streams.judgement: AHP pairwise judgements, tried in order: the team members' group judgements (scoring/expert_weights.json) where they exist and are consistent; else the literature-based judgements (scoring/literature_weights.json, classes from cited textbooks, papers and NASA records in scoring/literature_evidence.json); else the AI session's judgements from the NASA records (scoring/ahp_judgements.json).
streams.data: Relative importance of conditions in NASA measurements (scoring/data_weights.json), pooled into the judgement weights of the dimensions it covers.

_about.status: Config 1.4.0 (2026-11-14 20:19 KST, the human lead's decision): the judgement stream is the literature-based one for all three question types; suppression is pooled with the NASA FLEX data stream as in 1.3.0. Team members' judgements, if they arrive, come first; using them needs the human lead's decision and derive_weights.py --write.

suppression.why: FLEX (Flame Extinguishment Experiment) is the NASA suppression data set with a measured extinction response. It covers oxygen, pressure, diluent and fuel; it says nothing about flow (quiescent droplets), shape or the purpose of a study, so those keep their judgement weights. lambda 0.5 gives judgement and data equal say.
